The scrim behind a floating window becomes a token, and a darker one.

## ✨ Added

- **`--glim-scrim`, and `.glim-modal-backdrop` spends it.** It was `bg-black/60`, typed into each component that floats a window and again into each adopting app's copies of them - which is the shape the brand colours were in before this language grew tokens for those: a value the rule describes and nothing holds. Asked to change it, somebody has to find every place it was typed, and one adopting app turned out to have four scrims at two different strengths, the odd one at .50 for as long as it had existed with nothing able to notice.

## 🎨 Design

- **The scrim is darker: .65 on a dark ground, .55 on a light one** (*jdp, 12.09.2026: "ich würde die abdunkelung hinter einem schwebefenster nochmal 5 Prozent dunkler machen"*). At .60 the card in front and the page behind sit close enough in value that the eye keeps reading the page, which is the one thing a scrim exists to stop. Two values rather than one, because a light theme reaches the same separation with less.
